purpose: the pre-registration OCR_PROMPT_V2_NEUTRAL_FRAMING required the treatment prompt to be written, registered and hash-recorded BEFORE the first provider call. This artifact is that record. It is a COMPANION to the pre-registration rather than an edit of it, so the committed experiment hash 05185839e204ca61 stays intact and verifiable.

handwritten_cell.v1_head: You transcribe the handwritten Hebrew answer text (may mix English terms) in this exam answer cell. Ignore any red instructor ink.
handwritten_cell.v2_head: You transcribe the handwritten Hebrew text (may mix English terms) written in this box. Ignore any marks written in a different colour of ink from the main handwriting.
handwritten_cell.v2_full_text:
You transcribe the handwritten Hebrew text (may mix English terms) written in this box. Ignore any marks written in a different colour of ink from the main handwriting.
Rules:
1. Copy EXACTLY the visible text, word by word. Never complete, paraphrase, correct, or invent words. Fidelity over fluency.
2. If a single word is unreadable, write [?] in its place.
3. If everything is unreadable, output [unreadable].
4. Text struck through by the writer is cancelled - skip it.
5. Hebrew is written right-to-left; output the text in normal logical order (first word first).
Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"transcription": "<the text>"}

handwritten_line.v1_head: You transcribe ONE LINE of handwritten Hebrew (may mix English terms) cropped from a university exam answer sheet.
handwritten_line.v2_head: You transcribe ONE LINE of handwritten Hebrew (may mix English terms) cropped from a larger scanned page.
handwritten_line.v2_full_text:
You transcribe ONE LINE of handwritten Hebrew (may mix English terms) cropped from a larger scanned page.
Rules:
1. Copy EXACTLY the visible text, word by word. Never complete, paraphrase, correct, or invent words. Fidelity over fluency.
2. If a single word is unreadable, write [?] in its place.
3. If everything is unreadable, output [unreadable].
4. Text struck through by the writer is cancelled - skip it.
5. Hebrew is written right-to-left; output the text in normal logical order (first word first).
Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"transcription": "<the text>"}

one_variable_guarantee: v2 is constructed in code (roles.load_ocr_prompts) by replacing ONLY the leading framing sentence and concatenating v1's rules block verbatim. Byte-identity of every behavioural clause is therefore structural, and tests/test_ocr_prompt_v2.py pins it.
adapter_version_unchanged: ocr-primary-bench-v1 (scoring did not change, so the arm stays comparable)
annotation_risk: the deterministic pixel audit found ZERO red-annotated crops among the 32 (max red fraction 0.0), so removing the red-ink phrasing cannot introduce annotation text for this population. annotation_inclusion_error is still measured.
